question: Who can investigate an official-language complaint involving a Northwest Territories government department?
generated_answer:
The Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for the Northwest Territories can investigate complaints involving government departments. 

The Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for the Northwest Territories is responsible for ensuring that the rights of the public to communicate and receive services in both official languages (English and French) are respected. If you have a complaint about a Northwest Territories government department not providing services in both official languages, you can file a complaint with this office. 

The Commissioner of Official Languages for the Northwest Territories has the authority to investigate complaints and make recommendations to the government to address any issues. 

For more information, you can visit the Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for the Northwest Territories' website or contact them directly. 

Here is the link to their website: [Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for the Northwest Territories](https://www.officiallanguages.gov.nt.ca/)
